lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 埃莉诺先到窗边，后头跟着个提旧布袋的女人。
lines.en: Eleanor comes to the window with a woman carrying an old cloth bag behind her.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，店主。我领了客人来，你招呼精神点。
lines.en: Hey, shopkeeper. I brought you a customer today. Treat her properly.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，我姓索菲娅，是埃莉诺她妈。
lines.en: Hello, boss. I'm her mother, Sophia.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下来才两天，和她住配给站对面那间。
lines.en: We moved down two days ago. We're squeezed into the room across from the ration station.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 来了。
lines.en: Welcome.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 那屋窄得不行，并排过都难。
lines.en: The room's absurdly small. We have to greet each other before we can turn around.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 她从上头带下来的家当，半袋就装完，连牙刷都只一根。
lines.en: She brought almost nothing down. One toothbrush.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 上面批下来能取的就这点。缺的，我再下头买。
lines.en: What the paperwork let me take back is all I have. The rest I'll replace down here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 人还没下来时，我想她该是天天躲屋里数钱。
lines.en: I thought I'd come down and find her curled up counting coins.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 没成想她比我还先起，天天去配给站跟人核分量。
lines.en: Instead she's up before me every day, arguing with the ration station about weights.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我那叫掰扯？是他们分量给少了，我去说一声。
lines.en: Who's arguing? I was reminding them their scale's off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她压价是真下得去手。
lines.en: She haggles hard.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 把滑到台边的价签推回盒里你少插嘴。
lines.en: taps a finger on the counter Shut up.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……还有，你昨天说今天进货，进了没有？
lines.en: ...Also, you said you'd get a shipment today. Did it come?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 到的少。你看要什么。
lines.en: A small one. What do you need?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 隔着窗探过手，把他翻进去的领角掖出来还穿它扛货，领口都压死了。
lines.en: Reaches through the window and straightens his crooked collarYou wore this to carry boxes again. The collar is all flattened.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 怎么了？
lines.en: Hm?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你到哪家铺子都这么伸手给人理衣裳？
lines.en: Do you always fix the shopkeeper's clothes like this in someone else's store?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他哪算别人。
lines.en: He's not someone else.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……我是讲，我跟他已经好了。原想再拖两天跟你提。
lines.en: ...I mean, we're together. I was going to tell you in a couple of days.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 过两天。
lines.en: In a couple of days.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 眼神在窗里窗外扫了一回，又去看架子行，先看货。
lines.en: lets her gaze rest between them, then returns it to the shelf All right. Let's shop first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅没凑到两人跟前，仍旧立在外侧，从窗口朝货架望。
lines.en: Sophia stays clear of the two of them, looking at the shelves through the other side of the window.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我要的少。洗的，擦的，再挑几样经用的。
lines.en: I don't need much. Something to wash with, something to wipe with, and something that'll last.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，你手里这批货，有问题的都列给我听听。
lines.en: Boss, which of your goods have flaws?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 毛病我会先挑明。
lines.en: I tell people the flaws first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 举一个。
lines.en: For example?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 盖子扣不紧的，缝口开线的。我摆出来的都得能用。
lines.en: Lids that don't seal. Hems coming loose. I only put out what still works.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 倒放会渗的，你也不藏？
lines.en: And if it leaks when you turn it over, you say that too?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 也不藏。
lines.en: I say it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 数落自家货的时候，你嘴巴倒挺利。
lines.en: You're not gentle with your own stock.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 他就这样。我第一次买杯子，他先点着沿上的口子叫我看。
lines.en: That's him. My first time here, he pointed out a chip in a cup before I could.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我以前当他想挑毛病还价。
lines.en: Back then I thought he was trying to talk my price down.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 然后呢？
lines.en: And then?

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 后来……后来我天天往这儿跑。
lines.en: Then... hmph. Then I started coming every day.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把旧布袋搁上台面就这些。按日常价算。
lines.en: sets the old cloth bag on the counter That's all I need. Charge the usual price.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你自己看。
lines.en: Pick for yourself.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 就着窗口把货架打量一圈你平日怎么给客人说货的毛病？
lines.en: Studies the shelves through the windowHow do you usually point out flaws to customers?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 能瞧出来的，我都不盖。
lines.en: If you can see it, I won't hide it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 好。瞧出来的，我先记下。
lines.en: Fine. What I can see, I'll remember.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 价签没差。
lines.en: Matches the price tag.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 我早说过，他不乱要价。
lines.en: See? I told you he doesn't cheat people.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你念了三回不止。
lines.en: You've said that three times.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: ……两回。
lines.en: ...Twice.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 比价签低。看她的情面？
lines.en: Less than the tag. Because of her?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 只这回。
lines.en: This time.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下回按价。我下来了，账得分开算明。
lines.en: Next time, full price. I'm living down here now. The accounts have to be clean.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 母亲，他让利你就接着，别同他犟这些。
lines.en: Mother, if he gives you a discount, take it. Don't fight him over this.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 比价签高出不少。
lines.en: More than the tag by a stretch.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 喂，这数怎么回事？
lines.en: Hey, what's that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 别嚷。货我拿，钱不少你。
lines.en: Don't argue. I need the things. I paid the money.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把东西装进旧布袋老板，这账我记下了。
lines.en: puts the goods into her cloth bag Boss. I'll remember this.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 没挑中，就先不拿。
lines.en: Nothing suitable, then. Never mind.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 家里旧毛巾先顶几天吧。
lines.en: I'll use the old towels a few more days.

lines.speaker: SEC
lines.text: 下一批到了，给我先留出来。
lines.en: Next time you get stock, save some for me.

choices.description_zh: 先告诉她哪些货有毛病。
choices.description_en: Tell her what is wrong with the goods first.
Say nothing and let her look.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 索菲娅独自来的，袖口还带着点灰，往窗口前一站，眼睛先朝货架走了一遍。
lines.en: Sophia comes alone, dust on her cuffs, and looks over the shelves from the window.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 下午好。埃莉诺去配给站排着队，我一个人过来的。
lines.en: Good afternoon. Eleanor's queueing at the ration station. I came on my own.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 买什么？
lines.en: What are you buying?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 营养果。她吃烦了，我还没。
lines.en: Nutrifruit. She's sick of it. I'm not yet.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 以前我天天对着它们，反倒没怎么坐那儿剥开尝上一口。
lines.en: Up there, I was around them every day, but I rarely sat down to eat one.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 要多少？
lines.en: How much?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 先看货。
lines.en: Let me look first.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 来的时候，过道口躺了两个人，酒味隔着老远就往鼻子里钻。
lines.en: On the way here, two people were lying in the passage. You could smell the liquor from far off.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 大白天，旁边还蹲了一圈人在赌钱。
lines.en: In broad daylight, a ring of people squatting nearby, gambling with coins.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 再走几步，有人扛着箱子来回跑了三趟，就为多凑一顿饭。
lines.en: At the other end, someone hauling a crate back and forth three times just to earn one more meal.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 老板，你算哪类？
lines.en: Boss, which kind are you?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 卖货的。
lines.en: The kind with a shop.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 进得少，出得勤。账不拖，来路不明的货不接。
lines.en: Small shipments, sold fast. I don't extend credit long, and I don't take goods with no provenance.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 这些年就这么过来的？
lines.en: And you've lived like this all these years?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 没死。
lines.en: Still alive.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 实在。那我也问句不怎么实在的。
lines.en: Honest. Then let me ask you something less honest.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 胳膊往柜台边上一搭，轻轻笑了一下埃莉诺，跟花不完的钱，你挑哪个？
lines.en: rests a hand on the edge of the counter and smiles Eleanor, or money that never runs out. Which do you choose?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 埃莉诺。
lines.en: Eleanor.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 回得倒快。就不怕我当你净挑好听的？
lines.en: That fast? You're not afraid I'll think you're flattering me?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你出题，我只管答。
lines.en: You asked. I answered.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱去了还能再弄回来。
lines.en: Money runs out. It can be earned again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 她碰见你的时候，正走背运。饿着肚子，谁递口吃的都容易看成好人。
lines.en: She met you when she was at her lowest. At a time like that, anyone handing her a bowl of rice looks good.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我见过不少，把刚爬上岸的那口气，错当成了别的。
lines.en: I've seen plenty of people mistake the breath that got them through for something else.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 她自己分得清。
lines.en: She can tell the difference.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: ……是。她最烦别人替她拿主意。
lines.en: ...Mm. She does hate anyone deciding for her.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行，说回果子。
lines.en: All right. The fruit.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 你这里的货，好的跟次的分两堆？
lines.en: How do you separate the good food from the bad here?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 整的归整的，带毛病的归带毛病的，不掺着卖。
lines.en: Good ones on one side, lesser ones on the other. I don't mix them.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 有点磕碰的，果肉还不一定坏。
lines.en: The slightly flawed ones are still edible inside.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还能吃。你要，开个口。
lines.en: They are. If you want them, say so.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 零头呢？凑不整的那些。
lines.en: What about the odd amount? The part that doesn't round off.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 牌子写多少收多少，不加价。
lines.en: Charged by the tag. I don't round it up.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 场子里的人买东西，就怕最后几个小钱被人顺手摸进兜里。
lines.en: Back at our farm, the workers always feared someone would pocket the odd change.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 培育组把结果放出来了，往后这玩意说不定能再结籽，味道兴许好点。
lines.en: The research is public now. Maybe someday this thing can seed again, and taste a little better.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 不过那都往后了。今儿先吃现成的。
lines.en: But that's later. Today we eat what's here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 项目我已经交回去了，往后它结不结籽，跟我不相干了。
lines.en: The research went back. Whether this thing can seed again is out of my hands now.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 以后再说那些。今天先拎现成的走。
lines.en: But that's later. Today we eat what's here.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 抬了抬下巴朝货架点了一下拿几个我瞧瞧。整的要几个，带伤的也来两个。
lines.en: points at the shelf Let me see them. Pick a few good ones, and two lesser ones.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 换你你来，你拿哪种？
lines.en: Which would you pick?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 我丢出去的问，你倒先丢回来了。
lines.en: I ask you, and you push it back to me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 年轻时候我也挑过钱。后来全投进研究了，不悔。
lines.en: When I was young, I chose money. Spent it all on research. Don't regret it.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行，不接茬也算一种回法。
lines.en: Fine. Not answering is still an answer.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 钱没有花得完的时候。
lines.en: There's no money that never runs out.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那就是不肯挑。
lines.en: Then you won't choose.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 题出得不对。
lines.en: The question's wrong.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: ……你俩抬杠的时候，你大概也这样不肯顺着说。
lines.en: ...You argue with her like this too. Never following the easy line.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 好的坏的各算各的，零头没糊弄。
lines.en: Good and bad counted separately. The odd change is clear too.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 把带伤那个放手上颠了颠这个晚上切了吃。她听了八成又喊腻。
lines.en: weighs the lesser one in her hand I'll cut this one tonight. She'll probably say she's sick of it again.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 零头给我去了。
lines.en: You rounded off the odd change.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 就这一回。再往后照价签来，别瞧我的面子。
lines.en: Just this once. From now on, charge the tag. Don't do it because it's me.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 带毛病的也跟着好货喊价？
lines.en: Lesser goods at the price of good ones?

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 行。东西我带走，这话我记下了。
lines.en: Fine. I'll take it. And I'll remember what you said.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 今儿挑不着货。
lines.en: Nothing worth picking today.

lines.speaker: Sophia
lines.text: 那今晚吃上顿剩的。她问，就说我嫌贵。
lines.en: Then tonight we eat what's left of hers. If she asks, tell her I thought it was too expensive.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店里的灯关去一半，埃莉诺挨在窗口外头的柜沿上，人还没走。
lines.en: Half the shop lights are off. Eleanor leans against the counter outside the window, in no hurry to leave.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 配给站前头排得没完，我这两条腿站得直发硬。
lines.en: The ration line was absurd. My legs are stiff from standing.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 坐下。
lines.en: Sit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 拉过窗口下的凳子坐下，弯身捏了捏小腿我还没要你管。
lines.en: Sits on the stool outside the window and taps the back of his handYou don't have to tell me.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我母亲今天来过吧？一个人。
lines.en: Hey, did my mother come by on her own today?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 来过。
lines.en: She did.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她来买营养果的？
lines.en: To buy nutrifruit?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 对。
lines.en: Mm.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 上回剩下的半袋还摆在屋里，她非要自己出来买一趟。
lines.en: Ridiculous. There's still half a bag at home from last time. She had to make the trip herself.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她没拉着你问东问西吧？
lines.en: She didn't say anything strange to you, did she?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 问了货。
lines.en: She asked about the goods.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 光问货？
lines.en: Just the goods?

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 还问日子好不好过。
lines.en: And how I get by.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 她在上头那会儿就这样，问起事来没个完。
lines.en: That's how she is up there. She has to ask everything to the bottom.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 工人和她搭话，一天倒几班都能被她问出来。
lines.en: Same with the workers. She can get a person's whole shift rotation out of them.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 就是这两天肯开口了。头一天搬下来，她在床边坐了大半天，一句话都不说。
lines.en: ...But she's been talking more these two days. The day she moved down, she sat by the bed for ages without a word.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 昨晚又把我外套那粒扣子给钉了回去。钉得歪了，我也没提。
lines.en: Last night she sewed the button back on my coat. It's crooked. I didn't tell her.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不错。
lines.en: That's good.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 今天我替你整领口，正好让她撞上。
lines.en: Also, she saw me fixing your collar today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 我又不是特意当她面做。顺手就碰了。
lines.en: Don't think I did it on purpose. It was just habit.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 你老是顺手。
lines.en: You're always in the habit.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 攥住他的领口朝下一带，脸几乎贴上去你下回换件齐整的再过来。
lines.en: grabs his collar and pulls him close Then wear one that isn't crooked.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 还看？再看我真就不放开了。
lines.en: ...Keep staring at me like that and I won't let go.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: 不松手也行。
lines.en: I don't mind.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 哼，你说了又不算。
lines.en: Hmph. In your dreams.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 松开他的领口，指尖没离开，反而在扣子上按了两下今天我不早走。
lines.en: lets go of his collar but leaves her hand there, tapping his button twice I'm staying a little longer today.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 晚饭她揽过去了。我迟些回，她能把那间屋子照她喜欢的样儿理一理。
lines.en: She said she'd make dinner. I'll go back late and give her time to fix the room the way she likes it.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 你替我把那盏也关上。门外看着像收了摊就行。
lines.en: Turn off one more lamp. Just enough that it looks closed from outside.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: 店主伸手，把柜台上方那盏灯按灭了。
lines.en: The shopkeeper reaches up and turns off the lamp above the counter.

lines.speaker: Eleanor
lines.text: 从窗口探出身子，把头搁在他肩膀上……一会儿就好。
lines.en: Leans through the window, resting her forehead against his shoulder...Just for a while.
